profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Uber | Software Development, Engineering
profile.summary: Hi! My name is Nhi (like "knee") and I'm currently a Software Engineer at Uber.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
■ Developed a web app that allows students at UCSD to request tutor assistance in real-time using
React (JavaScript) and Docker
■ Worked closely with backend team to redesign and write new API requests using Axios and Python to
be scalable
■ Led weekly meetings and sprint-planning sessions to ensure team meets quarterly deadlines
■ Designed new UI based on feedback to improve user experience using Figma
■ Managed codebase with Git and reviewed pull requests to ensure all new code follows best practices
and passes all tests
■ Wrote documentation and created on-boarding process for new developer

positions.title: CSE Instructional Assistant/Tutor
positions.description:
■Tutored for multiple CS classes, including “Basic Data Structures and Object-Oriented Design” and  “Software Tools and Techniques”
■Relayed skills and best practices in vim, git, bash, shell scripting, Unix, Java, C and C++ to over 500 students per quarter

company.name: University of California, San Diego - Jacobs School of Engineering

positions.title: Uber Intern
positions.description:
Supplier Intelligence Team (Driver Engineering)
■ Quickly learned Fusion.js and GraphQL and built an internal tool (web application) from scratch for the Supplier Intelligence team to manage financial contracts
■ Designed an intuitive UI/UX in Figma that simplifies contract migrations for suppliers and reduces
work for the Operations team by 100+ hours
■ Adhered to best practices in engineering development cycle, including writing Engineering
Requirement Documentations, using Git for version control, and testing using Jest

positions.title: SPIS Mentor (Summer Program for Incoming Students)
positions.description:
■ Helped high school graduates transition into college-level Computer Science for UCSD’s Summer
Program for Incoming Students (SPIS)
■ Mentored students in machine learning, game dev, and web applications Python projects
■ Tutored and graded students on their weekly lab activities which primarily focused on algorithmic
problem-solving, mathematical modeling, and computer programming

positions.title: Bioengineering Intern
positions.description:
■One of nine students selected from the San Diego Unified School District for a 150-hour internship under the guidance of Dr. Karen May-Newman 
■Conducted research in the detection of LVAD pump thrombosis using intraventricular flow visualization
■Presented findings to graduate students, professors, and members of the public
